thread:
Marta: Quick sync 60mdash; proposing a cutline + risk ledger approach for MVP vs v1. Need alignment by EOD Friday. TL;DR: if we hit >20% scope shrink, we freeze MVP and push lower-priority items to v1. Thoughts? :clipboard:

Jessica: Can you call out which features are in the 20% bucket? Dev effort matters 60mdash; some small-features are deceptively expensive.

Marta: Good call. See the ledger below. I grouped by impact (customer-visible) + infra effort. Looking for objections before I put this in the roadmap doc.

Alex: Main ask 60mdash; enterprise SSO pilot is customer-blocker for Acme. If we cut it from MVP we risk pilot slipping. Suggest we classify SSO as "guardrail" not optional. @Marta

Omar: From design POV, we can reduce screen variants and still keep core flows intact. Prefer we cut polish (animations, microcopy variants) over core flows.

Kai: Infra note: some of the batching/caching pieces reduce cost but increase release complexity. If we push caching to v1, latency will be 15-25% worse on some tail queries. Need to trade off SLA.

Priya: Support impact: if we ship without the simplified onboarding flow, expect +30% tickets first week. We can mitigate with in-app helper but that requires design/dev time.

Marta: Ok 60mdash; here's a compact ledger for the cut decision (dev estimates are rough):
```
FEATURE                        | CATEGORY     | MVP?   | DEV WEEKS | RISK IF CUT
---------------------------------------------------------------
Tenant SSO (pilot)             | Security     | keep   | 4         | High (pilot)
Embeddings cache               | Perf         | cut->v1| 3         | Medium (cost & latency)
Onboarding helper (in-app)     | UX           | cut    | 2         | Medium (support load)
Polish: animations + variants  | UX           | cut    | 1         | Low
Canary autoscale tuning        | Infra        | keep   | 2         | High (SLOs)
Promptstore advanced filters   | Product      | cut->v1| 3         | Low
```

Jessica: I agree with moving embeddings cache to v1, but we should keep the autoscale canary. Will need a small spike to validate the autoscale policy before freeze.

Alex: Suggest adding gating metrics for the cutline: 1) Can we keep 95p latency under X ms? 2) Pilot sign-up readiness (SSO smoke pass) 3) Error budget < 0.5% on token serving. If any fail, we delay non-guardrail cuts.

Kai: I can run synthetic load and send numbers by Wed. Also: if we remove caching, token cost per request goes up ~22% (estimate).

Marta: Noted. Action items: @Jessica run spike for autoscale canary (2d), @Kai run synthetic load and share numbers (Wed), @Omar scope reduced onboarding helper mocks (1d), @Alex confirm pilot needs (ASAP), @Priya prep support comms for both MVP and soft-launch. I'll draft updated roadmap slice after those are in.

Priya: I'll draft a one-pager for CS & support with known limitations if caching is out.

ReleaseBot: Reminder 60mdash; next release window opens Thu 09:00 UTC. Please tag final cut decisions in the release PR.

Alex: Can we set a hard decision cutoff? Marta: EOD Friday works for me. If not resolved we'll default to "keep guardrails, cut polish + promptstore + caching -> v1".

Marta: Thanks all. If anyone has strong objections to the default, post them here before 18:00 Friday. :hourglass:
